reason: €35 every month per apartment plus €150 to start is real money on my income, and my laminated sheet plus the free Booking and Airbnb messages already answer the Wi-Fi and check-in questions. When a guest asks something odd, they phone or WhatsApp me anyway.
objection: I already get automatic messages free from Booking and Airbnb, so why pay a monthly fee for the same answers my printed sheet gives? And if it breaks, I have to wait for my nephew to fix it.
would_change_my_mind: If it were a single one-time payment with no monthly fee, or if a neighbour host showed me it really saved her hours of messages every week in season.
